notes.title: Version 10.11
notes.content: - fix for multiplayer coaches not being able to properly submit all files via FTP

notes.title: Version 10.10 update
notes.content:
-fix for HTML output of team logos on league leaders page
-fix for some suggestions not sticking when using phone to set them
-fix for team info graphic changes not displaying properly in some instances
-fix for rare issue using modded player photos causing stoppage at awards section

notes.title: Version 10.9
notes.content:
- Fix for error in player card stats when player is traded multiple times in season
- Improved save function

notes.title: Version 10.8
notes.content:
- Fix for updating multiplayer leagues and automatically loading them after download
- Fix to make insights page load better
- Allowed drop down MP users box to scroll for commissioner

notes.title: Version 10.7
notes.content:
- Fix for tiebreaker usage
- MP load will take you right to the league after league files have been downloaded
- Logo fixes on certain screens with custom logos
- Corrected eFG calculation on the leaders page

notes.title: Version 10.6 Update
notes.content:
- added your team record to daily schedule screen and will update along with next 3 opponents during simulations
- added fix for use while not connected to the internet
- fixed issue where team could receive an instant trade offer but then not having offering team accept deal
- fixed error where wrong FA demand is shown while looking at targeted list

notes.title: Build 10.5
notes.content:
The 10.5 build makes the following changes

- changed linking code to work with DDSCB21 as well
- fixed bug where leaders was displaying your team's % when looking at opponents
- fixed OEFF/DEFF calculation issue
